description.text: Fifteen single attacks (1.50 each), grants [Attach Earth 3 with Stacking], [Synchro Mode], [Damage Cap +10000] and [Stout Archer Mode] to the user

description.name: Attach Earth 3 with Stacking
description.text: Increase Attach Earth Level by 3 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 2, up to Attach Earth 3

description.name: Synchro Mode
description.text: Replaces the Attack and Defend commands

description.name: Stout Archer Mode
description.text: Casts Mash VIII after another ally uses an Earth ability, grants [Instant ATB 3] and [Earth Ability +30% Boost 3] after triggering six times, removed after triggering six times
